description.zh: 是否启用；正整数，只能是0或者1，0是停用，1是启用
description.en: Specifies whether the agent is enabled. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled).

description.zh: 多个座席号以英文逗号分隔 最多支持500个座席
description.en: A list of agent IDs, separated by commas. You can specify up to 500 agent IDs.

description.zh: 通过座席备注信息检索；取值说明：前缀模糊匹配
description.en: The agent comments to use as a filter. This parameter supports fuzzy matching by prefix.
The end of the creation time range to query. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

description.zh: 查询条数；正整数，大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: `1` to `1,000`. Default value: `10`.

description.zh: 通过座席名称检索；取值说明：前后缀模糊匹配
description.en: The agent name to use as a filter. This parameter supports fuzzy matching by prefix and suffix.

description.zh: 排序方式,按照创建时间排序；0正序 1倒序
description.en: The sort order by creation time. Valid values: `0` (ascending order) and `1` (descending order).

description.zh: 队列号；当qno不为空时，查询指定队列的所有座席记录
description.en: The ID of the queue. If a queue ID is provided, the operation returns all agent records in that queue.

description.zh: 是否返回绑定座席的队列信息；0:不返回 1:需要返回 默认值:1
description.en: Specifies whether to return information about the agent's bound queues. Valid values: `1` (returns queue information) and `0` (does not return queue information). Default value: `1`.

description.zh: 从第几条开始；正整数，大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The starting position for the query. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to `0`. Default value: `0`.
The beginning of the creation time range to query. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

description.zh: 是否在线；正整数，只能是0或者1，0是离线，1是在线
description.en: Specifies whether the agent is online. Valid values: `0` (offline) and `1` (online).

description.zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
description.en: The type of address to return for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values: `0` (enterprise default), `1` (public domain name), `2` (private domain name), `3` (public IP), and `4` (private IP).

title.zh: 座席详细信息列表获取
